reason: This is not a narrow refactor. It changes expression hash/canonicalization behavior across core optimizer and expression code paths, including constant propagation, predicate pushdown, column pruning, partition processing, index-merge planning, physical properties, and logical plan building. A new `CanonicalHashCode` that decouples from `stmtctx` can easily alter expression identity/equivalence semantics, which has high blast radius for planner correctness and executor-visible behavior if stmtctx-sensitive details (for example collation/timezone/type semantics) are dropped or changed. The file spread and touched subsystems make this central and risky enough for a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
